    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]

                orbit={(r,c),(r,w-1-c),(h-1-r,c),(h-1-r,w-1-c),
                       (c,r),(c,h-1-r),(w-1-c,r),(w-1-c,h-1-r)}
                vals=[grid[x][y] for x,y in orbit if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and grid[x][y]!=2]
                if vals: out[r][c]=vals[0]
    return out
''')
